open_status.evidence: As checked on 2026-11-06, the squaring.net catalog marks orders 38 and above incomplete. OEIS A129947 labels the 38–59 entries as upper bounds and gives 352 at order 38. The checked sources do not give a matching lower bound or an optimality proof for order 38.
open_status.source_location: Squaring.net order 38 entry; OEIS A129947 comments and order-38 term
open_status.claim_limit: This source review supports an open gap between a general lower bound and the 352 construction. It is not an exhaustive literature search.

historical_weaker_record.reproduction_status: Reported historically; not reconstructed in this task.

independent_quantity.method: Exact full vertical-section coverage and horizontal-length/cut certificates for every candidate rectangle; distinct sizes and primitive gcd independently checked.

parameters.object: axis-aligned tiling of an integer-sided square by 38 smaller squares
parameters.perfect: all 38 positive integer square side lengths are distinct
parameters.simple: no proper rectangle is tiled by a subset of at least two component squares
parameters.primitive: greatest common divisor of the 38 square side lengths is 1
parameters.objective: minimum outer square side length over all valid tilings
